articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Ripple- and Coinbase-funded PAC spends $2M in Florida race with little mention of crypto
articles.description: A Florida representative not running for reelection who voted against the GENIUS and CLARITY Acts has endorsed a Democratic candidate, possibly leading to PAC-funded negative ads.

articles.title: Cypherpunk launches Zcash mining fleet controlling 18% of network hashrate
articles.description: The $33.3 million Winklevoss Capital deal expands Cypherpunk’s ZEC strategy as it targets 5% ownership of the cryptocurrency’s circulating supply.

articles.title: Kraken’s Krak debuts US debit card as Payward broadens financial services push
articles.description: The multi-asset card lets US customers spend crypto and fiat and earn cashback as Kraken’s parent company expands across financial services.

articles.title: Federal prosecutors blast ex-Celsius CEO’s motion to vacate as ‘without merit’
articles.description: Currently serving a 12-year sentence in federal prison, Alex Mashinsky continues to explore legal avenues to vacate his conviction related to activities at Celsius.

articles.title: Metaplanet expands Bitcoin treasury strategy to US with 2,100-BTC Nasdaq play
articles.description: The proposed deal with Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise would give the Tokyo-based company a foothold in US capital markets while using existing Bitcoin rather than additional purchases.

articles.title: Neuberger teams with Securitize on multi-chain tokenized fixed-income fund launch
articles.description: The $613 billion asset manager will subadvise a high-yield fund tokenized across Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche and Sui.

articles.title: Bitcoin tags $65K as S&P 500 rebounds from 2-week lows on US-Iran rhetoric
articles.description: Bitcoin returned to $65,000 for the first time in a week as fresh BTC price volatility accompanied US claims that the Strait of Hormuz was “open and operating.”

articles.title: Toyota Finance opens tokenized bonds to retail investors via mobile payment app
articles.description: Retail investors can apply to buy the 1 billion yen bond without a securities account and receive perks through Toyota’s payment app.

articles.title: MoonPay adds Cash App Pay for crypto purchases by US customers
articles.description: Eligible US users can fund MoonPay crypto purchases with Cash App balances as the payments firm expands beyond its core onramp business.

articles.title: Kraken launches US-listed stock trading for EEA customers
articles.description: Eligible EEA users can trade conventional US shares alongside more than 700 tokenized xStocks through Kraken’s European entity.

articles.title: Bitcoin price spike to $64.5K was ‘low-volume liquidity trap’: Analysis
articles.description: Bitcoin derivatives markets created a short squeeze that took BTC price action 3% higher on Monday.

articles.title: China adds 8 banks to digital yuan network as operator count hits 30
articles.description: The newly authorized lenders will begin offering e-CNY services after completing operational and technical preparations.

articles.title: South Korea moves to block Polymarket over gambling concerns
articles.description: The Korea Media and Communications Commission said Polymarket’s structure and operations amount to illegal gambling despite its noncustodial design and smart contracts.

articles.title: BitBox patches ‘severe’ wallet flaws that could put funds at risk
articles.description: BitBox recommended all users update to firmware version 9.26.5 and said it had received no reports of exploitation or fund losses.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation warns some tools may break with Glamsterdam upgrade
articles.description: Developers have been urged to test on Plataberget before Glamsterdam’s new gas model reaches Ethereum’s other testnets and mainnet.

articles.title: South Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank taps Ripple for cross-border payments
articles.description: Ripple is bringing its cross-border payments platform to Jeonbuk Bank, but key details including its launch status and settlement asset remain undisclosed.

articles.title: Alleged $165M crypto Ponzi mastermind faces US charges after Fiji deportation
articles.description: Prosecutors allege Edward Zimbardi collected crypto from thousands of investors, lost over $34 million on currency trades and spent at least $10 million personally.

articles.title: ‘Fabricated rumors’ about BitMart founder, Binance bStocks dominate: Asia Express
articles.description: Binance’s bStocks are the second largest tokenized stock issuer just two months after launch, and BitMart’s internal feud erupts into the spotlight ahead of its closure

articles.title: OCC approves Trump family crypto company for trust charter
articles.description: The US financial regulator gave conditional approval for World Liberty Financial’s charter bid as ten Democrats signed onto a bill to “prevent corruption in banking applications.“

articles.title: Binance to plan UK relaunch with FCA license application: Report
articles.description: Binance’s UK arm has been barred from offering regulated activities in the country since June 2021, but the company will reportedly move to secure licensing under new crypto rules.

articles.title: CFTC seeks public input on AI compute futures contracts as CME eyes October launch
articles.description: The regulatory review could shape an emerging market that lets companies and investors trade and hedge the cost of increasingly scarce AI computing power.

articles.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
articles.description: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
articles.description: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

articles.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply despite $8.4B in unrealized losses
articles.description: Tom Lee’s Ethereum treasury company keeps buying the second-biggest crypto through the downturn, while more than 5 million staked ETH is projected to generate $287 million in annual rewards.

articles.title: Strategy raises $334M through stock sales but buys no Bitcoin
articles.description: Proceeds funded STRC dividends and repurchases, while $149.1 million was added to Strategy’s US dollar reserve, which reached $4.8 billion.

articles.title: Harmony plans rollback, wiping 109,000 transactions after ONE exploit
articles.description: Harmony said selectively restoring transactions could create inconsistent chain state, as Ravencoin faces a separate rollback dispute after an exploit.

articles.title: BTC price loses 200-week trend line as 2022 repeats: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin confirmed a weekly candle close below its 200-week moving average, copying the 2022 bear-market as traders warn of further BTC price downside next.

articles.title: Binance gave Russian authorities client data used in terrorism financing case: Report
articles.description: Reuters reported that Binance supplied transaction records and identity documents later used in a terrorism-financing case against Yuri Belenkiy.

articles.title: Bitpanda fined in Austria’s first published MiCA penalty
articles.description: The FMA said Bitpanda breached MiCA rules on crypto white papers and marketing communications, with the decision now final.
